identity.title: The global stability of the Kaluza–Klein spacetime

coverage.work: Read all hypotheses, vacuum constraints, wave-coordinate reduction, asymptotic mass tail, both weighted Sobolev tiers and L2 assumption, circle dependence, null frame, field commutators, exterior/interior regions. Literal domain and coefficient defects explicitly checked.

Traced wave-gauge improvement of LT components, exterior weighted Sobolev/Hardy estimates, null/cubic/weak-null interactions, commutators, derivative-weight improvement, Gronwall closure and lateral flux. Checked domain of the hyperboloidal path and uniformity of normalized time flux.

N>=14, N1=N-5; full and zero-mode energy hierarchy, Poincare, boundary Hardy terms, lower/higher derivative allocation, hyperboloidal second-derivative identities. Exact symbolic operator calculations include coefficient derivatives.

Good TU characteristic estimate and its application, weak-null decomposition, zero/nonzero mode commutators, high coefficient/low derivative Hardy treatment. Explicit smooth flat-metric counterexample to the printed auxiliary estimate, boundary geometry and mass-cone hypothesis checked.

Derived scaling-ray geometry and oscillator energy, checked initial-trace domain and source allocation, enhanced zero-mode energy, scalar-wave source split, mutual pointwise induction and final energy closure. Distinguished actual gaps from the intended c*sigma refinement; no unsupported circularity finding.

Energy flux normal and positivity, fixed-M versus uniform-M smallness, weighted Sobolev/Hardy statements and their boundary terms. Auxiliary metric witness calculated; not asserted to solve Einstein or gauge constraints.

Bibliography read; pinned TeX and BBL acquired with safe extraction, no author code executed. Relevant source formulas compared with actual PDF pages. Cited Huneau–Stingo arXiv2110.13982v1 Section5 read and pages28–32 actually viewed; full-reference audit not claimed.
